pro_course_detail.title: English Speaking and Conversation Class for Professionals: Phrases, Fluency and Idioms.
pro_course_detail.description:
Tired of textbooks? There's a reason for that. How we speak is something different from just good grammar. Did you know that a well-chosen phrase or idiom can make you sound more fluent? It's entirely possible to take your English from good to great with just a little attention to some new ways to phrase things. This course is especially for those times you want to work on your fluency, your pronunciation and usage, and it addresses both business and social environments. Learning happens in a natural and fun way, so you remember and can put your new knowledge into practice immediately.

The method I use in this class is collaborative. You practice real world conversation in a natural and relaxed way, with instruction and feedback/correction given in an ongoing responsive manner. New knowledge is integrated into the class in response to ongoing assessment. 

What this means is that we have a nice, interesting conversation. While we are chatting, I correct your mistakes in writing, and ask further questions to give you a chance to use your new knowledge. As we speak or as we are learning something, I am always doing assessment- finding the patterns in your speech that you can quickly improve to get better spoken English really fast. Quick grammar reviews are given in real time, only as mistakes are made. This is not a traditional grammar class!

*If you have Upper Intermediate English and would like to improve your English speaking, reading, listening, writing and presenting on issues in your field and other technical or complex topics related to tech, law, energy, AI, blockchain, or engineering, please see my classes “Tech Talk” and “Special Projects”.

pro_course_detail.title: Intermediate English Bootcamp
pro_course_detail.description:
This is the class you need to take to “level up” (to go from so-so to strong English).

We will practice all of the English skills: speaking, writing, listening, reading, and vocabulary. If you would like to focus on specific skills, for example, speaking, we can “place emphasis” (focus on) that topic until you feel confident. 

After your assessment test, I will create a checklist of what you will learn, provide materials for free, and help you fix your mistakes. 

The goal of this class is to help you “get unstuck” (move ahead quickly) and to enjoy and feel confident about using your English in real life.

pro_course_detail.description:

—Some projects I’ve worked on have been affiliated with Amazon, Microsoft, Google, 
Y Combinator, Apple, Citibank, Bayer, and various top universities. 
—Topics and areas I have worked with include: marketing, finance, software development, energy, AI, blockchain, start-ups, and government.

Depending upon the scale or duration of your task, we may need to meet for only an hour, or you can choose a package for ongoing development, if you need more preparation, speaking or writing practice, or skill development. 

This class is my passion and I so enjoy helping you do your best work.

pro_course_detail.title: English Speaking Practice and Terminology - Tech Talk
pro_course_detail.description:
If you love talking about AI, blockchain, the IoT, Agile, and all things tech, this is the speaking practice for you. 

This class is perfect for those of you who have already attained a high level of English, and simply need to keep practicing in order to sound more natural and keep your skills fresh. 

It is offered in a fluid, relaxed format using an interactive/responsive teaching style. We have a chat like co-workers or friends, and I will bring a discussion topic though either of us can introduce one. We might have a quick reading for reference to facilitate the discussion which may be taken from a tech article or Twitter or the latest news. The goal here is to improve your confidence in speaking by actually doing it in a simulated real-world conversation.

The hour-long class is for a once or twice a week speaking practice and the 30 minute session is perfect for when speaking several times a week for shorter sessions is important but you don’t have much free time.

This is a really fun class for fellow techies!

This class is perfect if you have a strong background, but don’t live in an English speaking country, and just need to practice more. If you need deep grammar work, please look at the Intermediate Bootcamp. If speaking with more confidence is your goal, this class is for you.
